Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

DIMENSIONS FOR 

MODULAR UNITS FOR MACHINE TOOL 

CONSTRUCTION-SLIDE UNITS 



1. Scope — Specifies certain dimensions relating to the interchangeability of slide units used in 
special purpose machines constructed from modular units. 

Note — Any type of drive mechanism may be employed on the slide units. 

2. Nominal Sizes — The nominal size of a slide unit shall be given by the nominal width of the 
saddle, W (see 3). 

2.1 The slide units shall have nine nominal sizes (see 3). 

3. Dimensions

*The dimensions given for the length of saddle L x , may be increased using values from the R10seriesof 
preferred numbers according to IS : 1076-1967 'Preferred numbers (first revision)', 

fThe dimensions given for the stroke 5 may be increased using values from the R5 series of preferred 
numbers according to IS : 1076-1967. If required other values may be chosen from the R10 series of prefer- 
red numbers. 

Any such increase will affect the overall length of the slide base L % by the same amount. 

tThe dimensions given for the height 'H' may be reduced using values from the R20 series of preferred 
numbers. This is intended to cater for screw feeding units and particular applications where multi-spindle 
units have to be positioned as low as possible. 

The height 'H' of 400 mm specified for the 800 mm nominal size is considered suitable for general applica- 
tions. This value has been adopted even though the logical progression of R 20 series would indicate a 
height 'H' of 450 mm,

IS : 9722-1981 

4. Designation — A slide unit of nominal size 250 x Stroke 250 mm x Height 250 mm shall be 
designated as : 

Slide Unit 250 x 250 x 250 IS : 9722 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

In the preparation of this standard assistance has been derived from ISO 2562-1973 'Modular 
units for machine tool construction — Slide units'. 

BS : 3384-74 'Modular units for machine tools'. 

DIN 69572-1979 Units for machine tools, slide or feed units, sizes'.
